name: Monthly Sales Summary
query:
SELECT
  YEAR(se.dated) AS `Year`,
  MONTH(se.dated) AS `Month No`,
  MONTHNAME(se.dated) AS `Month`,
  se.department AS `Department`,
  SUM(se.amount) AS `Amount`
FROM `tabSales Entry` se
WHERE se.docstatus = 1
  AND (%(year)s IS NULL OR %(year)s = '' OR YEAR(se.dated) = %(year)s)
  AND (%(month)s IS NULL OR %(month)s = '' OR MONTH(se.dated) = %(month)s)
  AND (%(department)s IS NULL OR %(department)s = '' OR se.department = %(department)s)
GROUP BY YEAR(se.dated), MONTH(se.dated), se.department
ORDER BY YEAR(se.dated) DESC, MONTH(se.dated) DESC
